title: Model Problems in Numerical Stability Theory for Initial Value Problems
read_scope: Abstract and introduction; dissipativity discussion in Section 5 and local-error-control discussion in Section 9. Not a full 32-page review.
finding: The review distinguishes finite-time convergence from long-time numerical stability, surveys dissipativity, and gives tolerance-scale bounds for certain adaptive schemes.
consequence: The general aim of bounding numerical orbits through error control is established. The present exact RK45 constants are experiment-specific certificates, not a new general stability theory.
